open_points.subject: Personal data disclosure to model providers
open_points.text: “Personal data — the customer's contact data (R0-06); readable by staff only (R0-09)” contradicts “every contact field it records or reads passes to the provider of the model the owner runs it on”
open_points.question: Does “readable by staff only” describe only Registry API authorization, with model providers explicitly permitted to receive the data as external processors, or must contact data remain undisclosed to every non-staff party?
options: Staff-only applies only at the Registry API boundary; the operator may disclose contact data to its model provider
Contact data must not be disclosed to model providers
Only specified fields or approved providers may receive contact data
open_points.default_guess: Treat the model provider as an explicitly accepted external recipient and interpret “readable by staff only” as an API-access rule.
